newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah firms on tightening liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah firms on tightening liquidity.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah firmed against the dollar in slow early trading on Monday on the back of tighter liquidity, dealers said.
"It's a dull morning. There is not much going on. It's more driven by liquidity," one local bank dealer said, adding that the dollar softened on fears of a tight rupiah market.
Spot rupiah was at 2,427.50/27.75 at 0300 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,429.0/30.0. Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,427.1/27.6 and 2,426.5/27.0, respectively.
Dealers said overnight money rose to a high of 15.0/16.0 percent before settling later at 13.0/14.0 percent.
The local bank dealer said liquidity worry might have also resulted from rupiah buying by some state banks late on Friday apart from a neutral central bank money policy on Monday.
They said liquidity fears also drove overnight swaps to a high of 0.77 points before easing to 0.45/0.55 points.

But another dealer said there was not much room for the rupiah to strengthen further because of the on-going election campaign which will last till May 23. He said many operators remained cautious of possible violence during the campaign ahead of polling day on May 29.
One-month swaps were at 13.5/14.0, two at 25.0/26.0, three at 37.0/38.0 and six at 75.5/76.5 points.
Bank Indonesia kept its intervention band at 2,407/2,599 and the conversion band at 2,409/2,457 on Friday.
